d:
In this ground report, The Lallantop reaches New Delhi Railway Station, one of India's busiest transit hubs, to cover an unexpected reality on the ground, an unusual slump in passenger crowds.
The significant drop in daily footfall and commuter rush at NDLS during Diwali has directly hit the livelihoods of those who depend on the station's daily movement. From auto-rickshaw and taxi drivers waiting for hours without a single fare to licensed coolies (porters) struggling to make ends meet, daily wagers are facing severe financial distress. Watch the report to know more.
Production: Rajat
